aggregation.timing: median/min/max across three seeds and three repeats, separately per phase
aggregation.speedup: median/min/max of matched baseline/candidate timing ratios
aggregation.additional_calls: two ordered calls; worker median summarized across nine workers
aggregation.memory: worker peak RSS; candidate-minus-baseline paired delta; no memory ratios
aggregation.matching: run, full archived configuration, policy, dtype, query count, seed, repeat, fingerprints
aggregation.record_indexes: zero-based positions in the source member's records array
